title: Add Play Store-ready Android app path via Progressive Web App (PWA) packaging

requirements.text: Add Progressive Web App (PWA) support for Meyouu so the website can be installed on Android and used in a standalone app-like mode.

quotes: Can you also make app of this website so i can upload it on playstore

acceptanceCriteria: A Web App Manifest is added and linked from the HTML entry point, with name/short_name set to "Meyouu", display set to standalone (or equivalent), theme_color/background_color set, and icons configured.
A service worker is added and registered to enable basic offline support (at minimum: cache the app shell and show an offline fallback page/message when the network is unavailable).
The app can be installed from a supported Android browser (“Add to Home screen”) and launches in standalone mode with Meyouu branding.
Existing routes (/, /listing/:id, /create, /my-listings) work when the app is launched from an installed icon (no blank page on refresh/deep link).

requirements.text: Create and include Play Store-suitable PWA icon assets and wire them into the PWA manifest (and apple-touch-icon where applicable).

quotes: Can you also make app of this website so i can upload it on playstore

acceptanceCriteria: All required icon files exist under frontend/public (or the project’s standard public assets path) and are referenced by the manifest.
Android install prompt uses the provided icons (192x192 and 512x512) without broken links.
No runtime console errors related to missing manifest/icon assets.

requirements.text: Add a simple in-app entry point for users to install the app on Android (e.g., an "Install app" button/link in an appropriate existing UI surface) with user-facing text in English.

quotes: Can you also make app of this website so i can upload it on playstore

acceptanceCriteria: The UI provides a visible way to install the app when the browser supports installation; otherwise it shows brief guidance (English) for installing via browser menu.
The install UI does not block core marketplace flows (browse, listing detail, create, my listings, purchase).

requirements.text: Add a repository documentation file describing how to publish the PWA as an Android app on Google Play using a Trusted Web Activity (TWA) wrapper, including required app settings (start URL, manifest location, icons) and high-level steps.

quotes: Can you also make app of this website so i can upload it on playstore

acceptanceCriteria: A clear English README-style document exists in the repo describing the Play Store/TWA approach and the values to use for Meyouu (app name, start URL placeholder, package name placeholder).
The doc explicitly notes what is and is not produced by this project (e.g., the web/PWA assets are produced; Play Console listing and signing are external steps).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead of editing).

Do not modify files listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Backend remains a single Motoko actor; no backend changes are required for the PWA request unless strictly necessary.
nonGoals: Building a native Android application in Kotlin/Java.
Producing a signed Android App Bundle (AAB) or uploading to the Google Play Console from this codebase.
Adding third-party push notifications or real-time socket features.

required: App icon in rounded-square style, warm amber/orange palette, simple marketplace mark (pwa-icon-192.dim_192x192.png)
App icon in rounded-square style, warm amber/orange palette, simple marketplace mark (pwa-icon-512.dim_512x512.png)
Monochrome maskable icon variant with bold simple mark (pwa-icon-maskable-512.dim_512x512.png)
Apple touch icon in the same style (apple-touch-icon.dim_180x180.png)
